newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Russian PM leaves Slovakia after three-day visit.
newsitem.headline: Russian PM leaves Slovakia after three-day visit.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin on Wednesday ended a three-day visit to Slovakia during which he signed several economic agreements and reaffirmed Moscow's negative attitude towards NATO expansion.
On Tuesday Russia and Slovakia signed a series of contracts aimed at enhancing the supply and flow of Russian natural gas to central and eastern Europe.
Russian gas producer Gazprom and Slovak gas distributor SPP signed a contract to form a joint venture to manage deliveries of Russian gas above contracted quotas to western Europe.
Chernomyrdin said Russia remained steadfastly opposed to the expansion of NATO. However, he said he did not want it to become a dominant issue in Russian-Slovak relations.

Slovakia has often said it wants to be among the first new members of the alliance, but its chances appear to have waned in recent months after repeated U.S. and European Union criticism of the pace of its democratic reforms.
